wsk2014Desc: Kazakhstan joined the WorldSkills Association in 2014 and has been actively participating in events. Each year, the importance of this championship among young people grows significantly.
assoctiationWsk: Kazakhstan joined the WorldSkills Association in 2014 and has been actively participating in events. Each year, the importance of this championship among young people grows significantly.
purpose: The main goal of the championship is to raise the prestige and rank of working and technical professions, attract young people to vocational and technical education, as well as train competitive specialists for the labor market and prepare regional teams for participation in the national WorldSkills championship.
wskMetodic: The WorldSkills methodology is one of the best practices in the world. According to this methodology, participants of the championship have the opportunity to determine their professional skills and demonstrate high performance. The requirements for the competition, held annually, are also constantly evolving.
studentsWsk: Our college students take part in the "WorldSkills Kazakhstan" championship every year.
april2015: In April 2015, at the First National Championship of Professional Excellence "WorldSkills Kazakhstan" in Nur-Sultan, 3rd-year student Raimbek Ishangaliev took 1st place in the competence "IT Network Systems Administration."
april2015Info: He later took 3rd place at the international WorldSkills championship in Kazan. In August, he participated in the WorldSkills International Championship in São Paulo, Brazil.
2015Info: In 2017, at the regional "WorldSkills Kazakhstan" championship, our college students became prize-winners in 4 competencies and earned a place in the national championship, where they won prizes in 3 competencies:
2018Info: In 2018, at the regional "WorldSkills Kazakhstan" championship, our college students won the Grand Prix in 8 competencies, qualified for the national championship, and became prize-winners in 4 competencies:
1st2018: "Web Design" - Ismail Simanov – 1st place at the national level
medalion2018: "Network and System Administration" - Amadey Urazbai – awarded a medal
2019Info: In 2019, our college students participated in the regional championship "WorldSkills Aktobe-2019" and became Grand Prix winners in 9 competencies, qualifying for the national championship. At the national championship in Nur-Sultan, they won in 4 competencies.
2021Info: In 2021, our college students participated in the regional championship "WorldSkills Aktobe-2021" and became Grand Prix winners in 11 competencies, qualifying for the national championship. At the national championship, they became winners in 5 competencies.
2022Info:
In 2022, students of our college took part in the regional championship WorldSkills Aktobe 2022 and became Grand Prix winners in 10 competencies, earning qualification for the national championship.

At the VII Republican Championship of Professional Skills, WorldSkills Kazakhstan 2022, held in 2022, the college competed in 9 competencies. Following the results of the national championship, the college became a winner in 5 competencies and achieved the following results: 1 gold medal, 2 bronze medals, and 3 Best Specialist Medallions of Excellence.

Thanks to these results, the college ranked 1st in the region, while Aktobe Region rose to 6th place at the national level.
1st2022Robot: 1st Place in the Mobile Robotics Competency
medalion_itBusiness2022: Best Specialist Medallion in "IT Solutions for Business" Competency
medalion_networkAdmin2022: Best Specialist Medallion in "Network and System Administration" Competency
medalion_graphDesign2022: Best Specialist Medallion in "Graphic Design" Competency
photo2022: Participants with the College Director at the VII Republican Championship «WorldSkills Kazakhstan 2022»
2023Info: In 2023, students of our college participated in the regional championship «WorldSkills Aktobe-2023» and became Grand Prix winners in 15 competencies, earning qualification for the national championship. At the VIII Republican Championship of Professional Skills «WorldSkills Kazakhstan 2023», the college competed in 9 competencies. Based on the results of the national championship, 3 participants were awarded the «Best Specialist» Medallion.
medalion_mobileRobotics2023: Best Specialist Medallion in "Mobile Robotics" Competency
medalion_mobileApps2023: Best Specialist Medallion in "Mobile Application Development" Competency
medalion_graphDesign2023: Best Specialist Medallion in "Graphic Design" Competency.
2024Info: In 2024, students of our college participated in the regional championship «WorldSkills Aktobe-2024» and became Grand Prix winners in 10 competencies, earning qualification for the national championship. At the Republican Championship of Professional Skills «WorldSkills Kazakhstan 2024», the college competed in 9 competencies. Based on the results of the national championship, the college became winners in 2 competencies and achieved: 1 gold medal, 1 silver medal.
1st_itBusiness2024: 1st Place in "IT Solutions for Business" Competency
2nd_graphDesign2024: 2nd Place in "Graphic Design" Competency. Participant in the International Championship «Euro skills-2025»
photo2024: Winners with the College Director at the Republican Championship «WorldSkills Kazakhstan 2024»
2025Info: In 2025, students of our college participated in the regional championship «WorldSkills Aktobe-2025» and became Grand Prix winners in 22 competencies, earning qualification for the national championship. At the X Republican Championship of Professional Skills «WorldSkills Kazakhstan 2025», the college competed in 9 competencies. Based on the results of the national championship, the college became winners in 3 competencies and achieved: 1 silver medal, 1 bronze medal.
3rd_businessAutomation2025: 3rd Place in "Business Process Automation on the 1C Platform" Competency
medalion_3dGaming2025: Best Specialist Medallion in "3D Modelling in Computer Games" Competency.
2026Intro1_pre: With the direct support of College Principal Zh.S. Mukhambetpaizova, the closing ceremony for the
2026Intro1_post: championship — a multi-day event filled with vivid impressions, spirited debates, and intense competition — was held at the highest level.
2026Intro2: This competition, which vividly showcased the professional skills and creative potential of the participating students, became an important platform aimed at improving the quality of education and developing the competitiveness of young professionals.
2026Intro3: The intra-college championship was organized across 36 competencies in the areas of information and communication technology, creativity and design, engineering technology, transport, construction, and social and personal services. Participants tested their knowledge and skills by completing tasks close to real production conditions, demonstrating a high level of professional competence.
2026Intro4: Winners who showed the best results were awarded a special letter of appreciation from the college principal and received a referral to the upcoming regional stage — an opportunity to showcase their professional skills at the regional level. Our graduates who won at regional and national stages in previous years passed the baton of victory to this year's contenders.
2026Intro5: championship was supported by representatives of social partner organizations who participated in both the event and the closing ceremony. They shared their experience, provided guidance to students, highly praised participants' preparation, expressed confidence in their future as qualified specialists, and emphasized that achievements are the result of consistent hard work.
2026Intro6: The winners who have earned a place at the regional stage are counted upon to uphold the honor of Aktobe Higher Polytechnic College and return victorious from the upcoming competition!
2026ResultsLead1: Students of Aktobe Higher Polytechnic College proved their professional skills at the regional «WorldSkills Aktobe–2026» championship and won prize places. This achievement demonstrates the high level of knowledge and experience of our students.
2026ResultsLead2: The perseverance and professional excellence of our students have brought glory to our college.
